description: Source code for GNSS dump functions, including conversion of fix status, quality, system to strings, and functions to dump GNSS info, navigation data, satellite data, and time to strings, with optional logging.

methods.name: gnss_fix_status_to_str
methods.description: Converts GNSS fix status enum to string.

methods.name: gnss_fix_quality_to_str
methods.description: Converts GNSS fix quality enum to string.

methods.name: gnss_system_to_str
methods.description: Converts GNSS system enum to string.

methods.name: gnss_dump_info
methods.description: Dumps GNSS info struct into a string buffer.

methods.name: gnss_dump_nav_data
methods.description: Dumps navigation data struct into a string buffer.

methods.name: gnss_dump_time
methods.description: Dumps GNSS time struct into a string buffer.
